Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: paisaje visual-development master for the Nasa Calderas/Tierradentro audiovisual bible. This is a source-cautious adaptation, not a sacred ethnographic portrait or exact cartographic reconstruction.
Primary request: Eye-level interior of a damp Colombian highland mountain forest: close broad flat-cut trunk silhouettes, paper leaf clusters, one traversable irregular path, small understory clearing and steep layered ground. Dappled restrained gray-green light; no tropical palms, vines spectacle, jungle waterfall, animals or characters.
Composition: Immersive vertical territorial/environmental master, oblique cinematic depth, three or more clearly separated paper planes, useful open staging space without an empty postcard.
Palette: cold river/paramo green, indigo, fog gray, restrained earth/ochre and raw-fiber beige as compatible with this subject; ordinary sober clothing, never decorative exoticization.
MATERIAL LOCK: ALL visible subjects, faces, clothing, animals, ground, water, sky, plants, architecture, objects and impossible effects are built from BROAD THIN MATTE DYED CUT-PAPER SHEETS. Exposed INTERNAL cut edges, deliberate simple silhouettes, overlaps, AIR GAPS and cast shadows between separated depth planes. Ground is LARGE FLAT OVERLAPPING PAPER CUTOUTS, never granular soil, sand, mud or realistic stone. Water and fog are BROAD FLAT PAPER SHAPES, never photographic fluid, foam, smoke or CGI. Rocks are folded/stacked paper strata; plants have flat cut stems and leaves. Faces are almost-flat paper with contour nose and minimal cut eye, NOT sculpted skin or faceted 3D heads. Raw wool and cabuya are SPARSE supporting seams or woven bands, never a substitute for cut-paper silhouettes. Clothing is broad paper pieces suggesting wool, not real fabric draped on a 3D doll. Rich cinematic spatial relationships, but NOT miniature-set photography. Full bleed INSIDE this paper world, no exterior box, tabletop, frame, corrugated cardboard or studio base.
ABSOLUTE CONSTRAINTS: image contains ZERO text, letters, numbers, labels, titles, captions, calligraphy, invented glyphs, watermark, logos or typography. The words in this prompt are instructions only, NEVER print them. No poster, illustrated encyclopedia page, grid lines or decorative border. No new unrequested subjects or objects. No Mesoamerican/Aztec/Maya/Inca imagery, feathers, sacred motifs, fantasy armor, ethnic caricature, photorealistic skin, clay, real wood, real metal, plastic, Pixar or Disney.
